title: The merge tool tells a replacement PR from a new one, so the replacement keeps the review rounds its source PR already owed
why: The merge tool cannot tell a replacement PR from a new one (lane fail-record-ancestor-head, recorded on PR 1957, 06:45 CST Nov 8). Replacement PRs are common (#1911 replaced #1907; #1371 replaced #1326). Re-scoped 14:31 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 14:30 CST): #2252 (review-state-guard-needs-round-3, with runner 8) fixes the symptom that a guard-yes record read done after a round 1 PASS. Left: link a replacement PR to its source so its owed rounds carry over. Check overlap with #2207 (replacement-pr-carries-review), which carries a passed record to a same-tree replacement.
note: Fix: a PR body line naming the PR it replaces carries the old PR's rounds into the new record, and a guard-yes record after a round 1 PASS on a replacement reads not done until rounds 2 and 3 land; red case first. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 06:47 CST Nov 8; the coordinator assigns a lane. Doing in lane fail-record-ancestor-head (session_013NEJKzYhDtNPLcEdeVFEVe) as a follow-up to PR 1957 (coordinator, 06:28 CST Nov 8). Open scope question with the coordinator: every guard-yes record, or replacement PRs only. Scope read by triage 06:51 CST Nov 8: past rulings answer it, so no page question. Item 359 b (owner, Nov 7 14:41 CST): skip round 3 unless the change touches a guard or check, or round 2 failed. Item 402 a: a guard or check change gets round 3 and the net-value test even after an earlier fix check passes. Neither is scoped to replacement PRs, so every guard-yes record owes round 3 (the lane's option a). The open PRs 1881, 1892 and 1951 owe their round 3 under those rulings. Covered by #1773 (the merge tool refuses a guard lane without round 3; rounds 1-3 PASS at e19ae8874); the coordinator stopped the second check (06:30 CST Nov 8). Done when #1773 merges. The lane sent PR 1773 one fix line: cite item 402 a beside 359 b (lane, 06:32 CST Nov 8). Sighting (lane commit-refuses-conflict-markers, 06:40 CST Nov 8): `merge --review-record --guard yes` printed a record with no Round 3 line and did not refuse; the lane handed #1937 that way and runner 8's hold caught it. The lane's proposed step review-record-needs-round-3 is folded here: #1773 should also refuse at print time, or this step names the gap. The print-time sighting is closed as by design: enforced at merge by #1773 (review_state and merge --confirm). A guard-yes record with no Round 3 line is valid mid-chain, since lanes post it after rounds 1 and 2 before any fix push (step record-before-fix-push) (coordinator, 06:42 CST Nov 8). Sighting 10:52 CST Nov 8: #1869 and #2136 (check changes, "Net value: not owed" after round 2). #1773 review_state keeps a Guard or check: yes record open below round 3, so it refuses these once merged; a record that says Guard or check: no escapes it (step merge-guard-flag-from-paths).
